GMB.note: Birth certificate is only an accepted application document; no record exchange stated.
No enrolment count or share given.
Cards are for citizens aged 18 and older; no number at birth.
Names the Immigration Department as past issuer but states no operation or maintenance arrangement.
No register keyed on the ID number stated.

facts.fact: The government announced that public registration and issuance of new Biometric National Identity Cards for citizens aged 18 and over started on 4 August 2026 in Banjul, Kanifing and Brikama areas, with rollout to other regions through September.
